name: Narambuenatitan
sum: Narambuenatitan is a lithostrotian titanosaur from the Campanian Anacleto Formation of Neuquen, Argentina, known from an incomplete skeleton.
wsnote: No body-size figure was read in the sources consulted.
holotype: MAU-Pv-N-425, an incomplete skeleton collected in 2005 and 2006.
biology: No biological statement was read in the sources consulted.
author: Filippi et al. 2011
